title: Polytheistical
summary: POLYTHEIS'TICAL, a. Pertaining to polytheism; as polytheistic belief or worship. 1. Holding a plurality of gods; as a polytheistic writer.

inlines.v: POLYTHEIS'TICAL, a. Pertaining to polytheism; as polytheistic belief or worship. 1. Holding a plurality of gods; as a polytheistic writer.
